title: Docs Infographics
subtitle: maude diagram primitives — 8 documentation diagrams (the visual spec for site/components/mdcc/diagrams/*, phase-17)
brief: Infographic/diagram primitives canvas for the maude docs site (dogfooding the design plugin on our own docs). 8 artboards, one per diagram component, real maude data, mono part-number stamps, strict 1px hairline structure, one indigo accent per board. Visual spec for the phase-17 docs-site diagram components.

artboards.label: A · MDCC-DGM/MAP · ArchitectureMap
artboards.note: System map: Claude Code shell + /plugin design + /plugin flow + maude CLI badge; .ai/ (flow) and .design/ (design) folder cards; crossing accent arrows design→.design/, flow→.ai/

artboards.label: B · MDCC-DGM/FLW · CommandFlow
artboards.note: Horizontal numbered step strip — install · maude init · /flow:init · ready; arrow glyphs between cells, last cell accent

artboards.label: C · MDCC-DGM/LP · LoopDiagram
artboards.note: 7-node circular cycle: init -> setup-ds -> new -> edit(active) -> critic -> handoff -> repeat; arrowed arcs + dashed accent closing arc + canvas-loop hub

artboards.label: D · MDCC-DGM/TR · CommandTree
artboards.note: ASCII command tree grouped Setup / Daily / Validate with hairline guides + mono glyph leaves

artboards.label: E · MDCC-DGM/FT · FileTree
artboards.note: .ai/ skeleton ASCII tree; workflows.config.json row highlighted (accent-tint + accent-muted left border) with right-aligned hint

artboards.label: F · MDCC-DGM/STT · StatPanel
artboards.note: 5-cell stat strip with hairline dividers: 42 commands · 11 critics · 2 plugins · 1 CLI · 0 telemetry (by design)

artboards.label: G · MDCC-DGM/INS · InspectorDiagram
artboards.note: Stylized canvas iframe (localhost:4711 chrome + dotted stage + 3 artboard rects) with accent two-stroke halo on the target element; 3 leader-line annotations (Cmd+Click · _active.json · /design:edit)

artboards.label: H · MDCC-DGM/SRV · DevServerSchema
artboards.note: Three-pane schema _server.json · _active.json · _history/<slug>/ with real keys + types; producer->consumer flow row (server writes -> inspector pushes -> rollback reads)
